def avg_rate(series):
    """Return the average rate of change per unit time, rounded to 2 decimals."""
    start_time, start_value = series[0]
    end_time, end_value = series[-1]
    return f"{(end_value - start_value) / (end_time - start_time):.2f}"


measurements = [[0, 0], [1, 10], [10, 100]]
result = avg_rate(measurements)  # "10.00"

# Confidence: 100%
